For unit z, putting a=‖Tz‖ bounds the dual pairing by ‖u‖[a+ρ√(a−a²)], since zᵀTz≤a and a≤δ²/(1+δ²). Scalar concavity gives the interior optimum a*=(1+1/√(1+ρ²))/2 for ρ>0 and the cap for ρ=0.
